Class Database

    • getAllUsers

      public List<User> getAllUsers()

      Method: List getAllUsers()

      Description: Generate a List of User objects, one for each user record currently in the userDB table. Used by the Admin "List All Users" function to display the username, full name, email address, and assigned roles for every user in the system.

      Returns:
      a list of User objects, one per row in the userDB table. The list is empty (never null) if there are no users or if a database error occurs.

    • loginAdmin

      public boolean loginAdmin(User user)

      Method: boolean loginAdmin(User user)

      Description: Check to see that a user with the specified username, password, and role is the same as a row in the table for the username, password, and role.

      Parameters:
      user - specifies the specific user that should be logged in playing the Admin role.
      Returns:
      true if the specified user has been logged in as an Admin else false.

    • loginRole1

      public boolean loginRole1(User user)

      Method: boolean loginRole1(User user)

      Description: Check to see that a user with the specified username, password, and role is the same as a row in the table for the username, password, and role.

      Parameters:
      user - specifies the specific user that should be logged in playing the Student role.
      Returns:
      true if the specified user has been logged in as an Student else false.

    • setOneTimePassword

      public boolean setOneTimePassword(String username, String oneTimePassword)
      Sets a one-time password for a specified user. The password is stored in the normal password field and the oneTimePassword flag is set to TRUE.
      Parameters:
      username - the user receiving the one-time password
      oneTimePassword - the temporary password
      Returns:
      true if the update was successful
